enemies.name: The Payroll Safe
enemies.desc: The miners' wages. Keep the machines off it and some of it is yours.

enemies.name: Signal Pylon
enemies.desc: Hastes every machine on the board. Break it.

enemies.name: The Prompter
enemies.desc: Holds the script. Without them, nobody remembers how this ends.

encounters.name: The Pack
encounters.desc: Fast hounds that hunt whoever stands alone. Machines don't bleed or sicken.
encounters.intro: Somebody let the dogs out. The dogs are mostly rivets.

encounters.name: The Firing Line
encounters.desc: Gunners behind crates. When one winds up Full Pressure, get out of its line.
encounters.intro: Gunners. They take a moment to build up pressure. Use the moment.

encounters.name: Mite Infestation
encounters.desc: Mites run at you and explode. Shoot them early, keep apart.
encounters.intro: Mind your feet. They're fond of feet.

encounters.name: The Tinker's Yard
encounters.desc: The tinker builds crates for cover and electrifies the floor. Get to it before the yard is all crates.
encounters.intro: The tinker is building something. It's usually a wall.

encounters.name: Boiler Room
encounters.desc: Golems resist blades and fire and explode when they die. Cold cracks them. Don't stand next to one when it goes.
encounters.intro: It's warm in here. It's going to get warmer.

encounters.name: The Counting House
encounters.desc: Counting machines move one tile every time anyone rolls a die. Every attack you make brings them closer. Spells with no roll do not.
encounters.intro: They count. Every roll you make, they count, and they come closer.

encounters.name: The Rail Yard
encounters.desc: Live rails across the yard shock whoever crosses them. Hounds don't care; you should.
encounters.intro: Mind the rails. They are live. Most things here are.

encounters.name: The Payroll
encounters.desc: Protect the payroll safe. Mites will try to blow it open. Waves in rounds 2 and 3.
encounters.intro: Guard the wages. The machines have never been paid and they would like to start.

encounters.name: Signal Pylons
encounters.desc: Two pylons haste every machine each turn. Break both to win.
encounters.intro: The pylons tell the machines to hurry. Turn them off.

encounters.name: Shift Change
encounters.desc: Hold out for 4 rounds until the shift whistle.
encounters.intro: Four rounds until the whistle. Nobody works past the whistle. Nobody.

encounters.name: The Under-Foreman
encounters.desc: Kill the under-foreman (the elite tinker) and the shift walks off.
encounters.intro: The under-foreman. Nobody likes him. Including the machines.

encounters.name: Out Through the Mineshaft
encounters.desc: Get every hero onto the exit tiles. Killing everything works too.
encounters.intro: There's a shaft. It goes up. Nobody's sure where.

encounters.name: Steam Tunnels
encounters.desc: A tunnel full of gunners and steam. Pipes burst every round.
encounters.intro: The tunnels leak. Breathe shallowly.

encounters.name: Assembly Line
encounters.desc: An assembly line of machines. The counting machine comes closer with every roll.
encounters.intro: Everything here is being made. You're next on the line.

encounters.name: The Iron Deputy
encounters.desc: High Noon is announced three turns ahead: a cross of tiles takes 6d6. Be elsewhere. The lasso tries to keep you there.
encounters.intro: The deputy. He announces exactly when he will shoot you. He has never been late.

encounters.name: The Furnace
encounters.desc: Two veteran boilers and a tinker. Cold is your friend.
encounters.intro: The furnace never goes out. They feed it.

encounters.name: The Accountants
encounters.desc: Three counting machines. Every roll pulls them in. Use spells and cards that don't roll when you can.
encounters.intro: The accountants. They are very patient and they count everything.

encounters.name: The Kennel Master's Dogs
encounters.desc: Surrounded by veteran hounds, and they go first.
encounters.intro: The good dogs. The best dogs. They go first.

encounters.name: The Duelist Engine
encounters.desc: Every round it calls a hero out: Grace save or take 2d8. Win the duel and it is exposed for a round.
encounters.intro: It has been waiting at the end of the street since the street was built.

encounters.name: The Clockwork Foreman
encounters.desc: He rewrites the action economy: Overtime gives his side an extra action, Clock Out takes your bonus actions. Watch the rule rack and plan for the next round.
encounters.intro: He decides when you clock in. He decides how many hands you get.

encounters.name: The Unpainted
encounters.desc: Unpainted miniatures learn your cards when they hit you. Unpainted tiles daze anyone who ends a turn on them.
encounters.intro: I never finished these. They have been finishing themselves.

encounters.name: Erasure
encounters.desc: The wraith rubs the board out. Erased tiles are gone, and so is anything shoved into them.
encounters.intro: Mind the gaps. They are new.

encounters.name: In Session
encounters.desc: The rules lawyer adds amendments while it lives: its side crits more, your feet get heavier.
encounters.intro: The rules lawyer would like to raise a point of order. Several.

encounters.name: Loaded
encounters.desc: Each die rolls itself every turn and does what comes up. A six hurts everything near it.
encounters.intro: These are mine. They don't do what I tell them either.

encounters.name: Paper Soldiers
encounters.desc: Paper knights crit on 18-20 and burn very well.
encounters.intro: Paper soldiers. Sharp edges. Keep them away from the candles. Or don't.

encounters.name: Notes in the Margin
encounters.desc: Scribblers mark targets and doodle over the board. The lawyer amends the rules.
encounters.intro: Somebody has been writing in the margins of my campaign.

encounters.name: The Edge
encounters.desc: Two wraiths erasing the board while a knight holds the line. There won't be much floor left.
encounters.intro: This is the edge. Beyond it, I didn't write anything.

encounters.name: The Prompter
encounters.desc: Keep the prompter alive: without the script, nobody knows how this ends.
encounters.intro: The prompter. Keep them breathing. I need them for the ending.

encounters.name: Second Draft
encounters.desc: Survive 4 rounds while the Caller redrafts the page.
encounters.intro: Hold on. I'm rewriting this bit.

encounters.name: The Editor
encounters.desc: Kill the editor (the elite lawyer) and the draft collapses.
encounters.intro: The editor wants to cut you. From the campaign.

encounters.name: The Cast Party
encounters.desc: Everyone from the last Book at once.
encounters.intro: Everyone came. I wasn't expecting everyone.

encounters.name: The Blank Pages
encounters.desc: A hole in the middle of the board and a wraith making more.
encounters.intro: These pages were blank. Somebody has been drawing holes.

encounters.name: The Understudy
encounters.desc: It learns one of your heroes' cards every turn. End it quickly.
encounters.intro: My understudy. It has been watching you very closely.

encounters.name: The Tribunal
encounters.desc: Two lawyers amending the rules every round. Expect a crowded rule rack.
encounters.intro: The tribunal is in session. The rules are what they say they are.

encounters.name: Double Six
encounters.desc: Two veteran dice. Keep your distance when they roll sixes.
encounters.intro: Double six. My favourite. Not yours.

encounters.name: The Heap of Failures
encounters.desc: It sheds failed miniatures and heals whenever one dies near it. Fire works well.
encounters.intro: Every miniature I ever gave up on.

encounters.name: THE HOUSE
encounters.desc: The Caller's own piece. A new house rule every round; his spare faces below 60%; Last Call below 30%.
encounters.intro: There is one piece left on the board. It is mine.
